scripts.title: Nexus keyless script
scripts.features:
COMBAT

Auto Block — angle-aware blocking with auto punish, auto counter and M1 catch. Per-target locking, "ignore own attacks", a live block-angle readout, and tunable block range, hold and attack window.

Dash Assist / BFC — dash chaining built around a Black Flash chain. Configurable arc and curve (with curve cycling and a curve floor), target prediction, block break, and side-dash assist with optional camera lock.

Combat — reactive teleports, forced last M1 (uppercut / downslam), ability-hook auto-deactivate, and per-character auto routines for Nanami, Hakari, Gojo, Megumi, Higuruma, Haruta, Ryu, Yuki and Todo. Plus hitbox expander, orbit target, invisibility and noclip.

Kill All — Noclip, Bypass (drives the game's own Reset remote in a loop until the teleport actually sticks), TP All, View Random, a one-shot BYPASS TEST pass, and a status row with a red/green dot so the state is read, never guessed.

AIM

Lock On — prediction with smoothing compensation, target modes, and camera lock with side / height / distance offsets.

VISUAL

ESP — corner boxes, full boxes, outlines, head dots, skeletons, tracers, and per-side labels for name, character, distance, kills and stun, plus health bar and text. Chams including evasive and stun variants, a cooldown revealer, item ESP, and a live character preview rendered in a ViewportFrame from your own avatar.

Anim Filter — browse, filter and preview animations, and drive them with custom animation flags.

PLAYER

Misc — infinite jump, infinite dash, auto roll, walkspeed, anti-stun, no block slow, walk into domains, fly, auto surf tech, auto head tap, extra emote slot, avatar scramble / copy / restore, instant respawn, item grabber, teleport attack and a mobile button layer.

Aura — effect and character aura controls with rainbow and gradient cycling.

Auto Piano — MIDI player with play / pause / stop, keybinds, a file browser and direct .mid download from a link.

SYSTEM

Config profiles (save / overwrite / load / refresh / delete), keybinds, script unload.
